# Lumora Sleep

> Lumora is a sleep mask in development, built by one founder. The design goal is to use motion and temperature readings from a small pod in the mask to wake the wearer during lighter sleep, inside a window they choose, with gradually brightening light. Prototype today: a bench pod with a motion sensor, a temperature sensor, a warm LED, and Bluetooth. The wake window has not been tested yet; that is the next milestone. Nothing is for sale. Planned launch pricing is from $129 on Kickstarter, with retail planned at $179 to $199.

The single action on the site is joining the waitlist for launch updates at https://uselumora.co/waitlist. There is no checkout, reservation, or deposit.

## Product

- [Lumora](https://uselumora.co/explore): One sleep mask, in development. Built: motion and temperature sensors and a warm LED on a bench prototype pod. Next test: whether those readings can guide wake timing. Planned: a gradual sunrise inside the mask and a passive cooling insert. No built-in sound and no powered heating or cooling. The 3D model on the site is a design render.
